name: The Long Way Home
description: Design a miniature garden by editing walls and inspecting its shortest route.
natural_language: Edit the garden so all floor tiles are connected and the shortest entrance-to-home route is exactly the requested number of steps. Stone planters and the two gates are fixed. Test reveals the current route. Certify when satisfied.

metadata.notes: Original garden editor inspired by the binary PCGRL problem. Fixed entrance and exit, exact route target, brush editing and route overlay are original adaptations. Provisional baseline L3/full; no human or agent calibration.
